title: GTA 6 cops remember you: the Heat system explained
yt_title: GTA 6 cops REMEMBER your face 👮 Heat explained
description: Will GTA 6 cops remember your face? Yes: the new Heat system. red icons under your wanted stars show what the police know about you: your face, clothes, vehicle, weapon, accomplice or a security camera. Hide your weapon, change clothes, swap the car or split from your partner to wipe that Heat (GamesRadar, GameSpot, VGC). Rockstar's Rob Nelson says they wanted police with a more persistent memory. At six stars there's no way out: it only ends when you're caught or killed (GamesRadar, PC Gamer). No spoilers. What's your best escape? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (unofficial): star colors meaning different police states, inferred by GamesRadar from preview footage.

lines.text: Red icons under your stars show what they know: your face, your clothes, your car, your weapon, your partner, or a security camera.

lines.text: And most of it can be wiped. Hide the weapon, change clothes, swap the car, or split up.
lines.headline: 3/4 · LOSE THE HEAT

lines.text: The star colors reportedly mean something too. Gray would mean they know who you are. That's not official yet.
lines.headline: STAR COLORS?

items.t: Gray stars = they know who you are

lines.text: But at six stars, nothing works. No disguise, no new car. It only ends when you're caught or killed.
